subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support add both `channels.signal.linkPreview` and explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default, per-account, primary-device, and container-mode semantics should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the default behavior, linked-device failure mode, container scope, and untrusted preview metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add Explicit Safe Support
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that preserves unset behavior, only sends caller-provided preview fields, and documents primary-device/container limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

options.title: Defer Behind Security Design
options.body: Keep the request open until the related link-preview metadata security issue defines whether OpenClaw may fetch or inject preview metadata.

options.title: Decline Signal Preview Control
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw should not manage Signal link-preview generation and document that operators must configure signal-cli outside OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Safe Support
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal setting that preserves unset behavior, only sends caller-provided preview fields, and documents primary-device/container limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already provided public implementation/security context on this issue.
